newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Spotless buys Clifford Hallam for A$17.8mln.
newsitem.headline: Spotless buys Clifford Hallam for A$17.8mln.

text.p: Spotless Sevices Ltd said on Wednesday that it had acquired Clifford Hallam Pharmaceuticals Pty Ltd from Sonenco Investments Pty Ltd for A$17.8 million.
Clifford Hallam distributed pharmaceutical products to major private and public hospitals and health institutions, mainly in the states of New South Wales and Queensland, Spotless said.
The company's estimated turnover in the year to June 30 was A$110 million.
